choice_and_context: One modular Flask application. Separate identity, cases, communications, referrals, administration and audit responsibilities. Route handlers call services, which enforce policies and use repositories.
consequences_and_review_trigger: Modules share a deployment. Reconsider service separation only when independent scaling or operational ownership justifies it.

choice_and_context: Server-rendered Jinja HTML, accessible forms and limited JavaScript. Use POST for state changes and redirect after successful forms.
consequences_and_review_trigger: Less suitable for complex offline interaction, which is outside this release.
status: implemented local scope; production target remains conditional; see runtime-status.md

choice_and_context: MongoDB with explicit validators, indexes and PyMongo repository access. Use a replica set and transactions for related case, event, audit and outbox writes.
consequences_and_review_trigger: The domain has relationships that MongoDB will not enforce as foreign keys. Services must enforce references and lifecycle consistency. SQLite is simpler for a small single-host system, but the selected client/server database supports the intended multi-instance deployment path.
status: implemented local scope; production target remains conditional; see runtime-status.md

choice_and_context: Production target: university OpenID Connect identity provider using authorisation code flow with PKCE, validated issuer, audience, state and nonce. Map verified issuer plus subject to an internal account. Privileged staff require MFA through the identity provider.
consequences_and_review_trigger: Institutional registration remains unavailable. Explicit user instruction adds local-only synthetic student self-registration through the existing OIDC provider; production forbids enablement. Staff/privileged access stays approval-controlled. No app password login or default live passwords. See account-profile-contract.md.
status: implemented local scope; production target remains conditional; see runtime-status.md

choice_and_context: Opaque random session token in a Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie; hashed token and session state held server-side. Rotate on authentication. Proposed idle expiry: staff 20 minutes, students 30 minutes; absolute expiry 8 hours. Validate expiry and account/membership status on requests.
consequences_and_review_trigger: Requires shared session storage and explicit CSRF tokens. Expiry values need usability review. Logout invalidates the local session; identity-provider logout behaviour must be documented separately.
status: implemented local scope; production target remains conditional; see runtime-status.md

choice_and_context: A separate worker polls a transactional outbox, takes time-limited leases and sends generic notifications. Use bounded retries, backoff and a dead-letter state with an operational alert.
consequences_and_review_trigger: Delivery is at least once; a crash after sending may cause a duplicate. Use provider idempotency where available and stable event keys. Never claim exactly-once delivery.
status: implemented local scope; production target remains conditional; see runtime-status.md

choice_and_context: HTTPS edge/reverse proxy → Gunicorn WSGI application → private MongoDB. Separate worker identity. Database has no public inbound access. Start with one application deployment; add instances after testing. Development debugger disabled.
consequences_and_review_trigger: Hosting vendor and cost remain undecided. Trust forwarded headers only from the configured proxy; configure allowed hosts explicitly.
status: implemented local scope; production target remains conditional; see runtime-status.md

choice_and_context: TLS for network connections; encryption at rest for database volumes, snapshots and backups; keys managed separately from backups with restricted access. Keep case content out of logs, email, URLs and cookies.
consequences_and_review_trigger: At-rest encryption does not prevent an authorised application or compromised privileged account reading data. Field encryption needs a separate key/search design if the threat assessment requires it.
status: implemented local scope; production target remains conditional; see runtime-status.md

consequences_and_review_trigger: Production readiness additionally requires operational ownership, recovery exercises and institution-approved policies.
